icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE mobile paid-feature icon matching the attached USER REFERENCE extremely closely. This reference is the final art direction. Preserve its visual grammar: a perfectly circular warm golden-yellow to orange gradient disc, bright lemon-gold at upper left and rich tangerine at lower right; a warm ivory / cream solid functional glyph on top, subtly raised with a small soft amber shadow toward lower right. Almost front-facing shallow 2.5D bas-relief, restrained soft edge highlights and very small rounded bevels. Simple iconic silhouette with clear negative spaces, not a realistic scene or a flat thin outline. Faithfully match the reference's friendly but polished commercial membership icon finish, cream material, saturation, circular base and lighting. The circle must be completely round, centered in a square canvas, and fill 90 percent of its width and height with equal narrow transparent margins. Center the glyph within the circle, occupying about 58 percent of the circle diameter. ONLY change the central feature symbol to the subject below. Do NOT copy the Chinese caption from the reference, do NOT add any text/letters/numbers. Outside the circular disc must have true alpha transparency. No white rectangle or checkerboard, no outer scene/background, no giant drop shadow outside circle. No glass, no chrome, no gold metallic frame, no gemstones, no realistic shiny metal, no cobalt blue or purple, no robot face, eyes, mascot, cartoon character, no tiny scatter decorations. Single self-contained icon, no label, no watermark. Legible at 48 CSS pixels. SUBJECT: AI assistant. One compact solid warm-cream conversation bubble silhouette with a short lower-left tail. A clear four-point intelligence sparkle is cut through its central face, exposing the orange circle below. Make the central sparkle large and clean. The cream bubble has the same shallow raised relief and soft lower-right shadow as the reference. No additional objects, no robot, no tiny stars.

background.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: EMPTY vertical background artwork for a premium school-edition feature card in a teacher mobile app. The attached user reference and icon are STYLE AND COLOR references only: sunny golden-yellow to tangerine orange, warm ivory, soft shallow bas-relief. Create ONLY an elegant understated background; absolutely NO ICONS, NO SYMBOLS, NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO LOGO, NO BADGES, NO UI, NO PRICING, NO BORDER, NO CARD MOCKUP. A vertical 2:3 composition meant to sit BEHIND a real HTML heading plus four feature rows. At least 85 percent of the whole image, especially all of the left 80 percent and the entire center, must be quiet warm ivory / near-white (#FFFCF5 to #FFF8E9), very light and uniform enough for dark small mobile text to remain perfectly legible. Subtle warm golden illumination in the upper right corner softly washes toward the top, like soft morning light through honey-colored translucent material. At the extreme upper-right edge, one or two beautifully smooth thin curved layers in very pale champagne and cream create restrained shallow embossed relief; these forms stay mostly cropped OFF the image. A similarly faint curved contour may appear only at the extreme lower-right edge. Fine edge highlights and soft short shadows, very low contrast, no high-frequency pattern. The golden/orange color stays pale and localized at edges, not a saturated orange field. Sophisticated commercial membership-benefit card background, light, warm, calm and clean. Match the reference's softness and cream/gold relationship without copying the circular icon or the puzzle glyph. No sparkles, no coins, no crowns, no gradients with pink/purple/blue, no confetti, no dramatic illumination, no dark areas, no children's illustration, no plastic toys, no full circular disk, no giant central objects. Opaque near-white background. Polished, restrained, spacious.

contactQr.mode: built-in imagegen edit, then lossless black-and-white cleanup
contactQr.validation: Apple Vision detects one QR code in both source and output, with identical decoded content
contactQr.prompt: Edit the supplied real, functioning contact QR-code bitmap. Deliver one clean square 1024x1024 PNG. This is an EXACT technical image restoration and cropping job, not a creative redesign. Crop the excessive and uneven white background, center the entire ORIGINAL black QR pattern and ORIGINAL central WeChat-style icon in a square, retain an even white quiet zone of at least four QR modules on ALL four sides. Increase resolution and crispen existing edges. CRITICAL INVARIANT: every original black and white encoded module, its position and spacing, all three rounded corner finder patterns, the small lower right alignment marker, and the central icon MUST remain exactly identical to the input. Merely upscale and reposition the exact existing pixels, without inventing, rearranging, regenerating or changing a single encoded module. Output pure white background and crisp black graphics, no captions, no text, no border, no shadows, no additional elements. The code must decode to exactly the same content as the original. Keep square geometry, no perspective or warping.

personalBackground.prompt: Edit the supplied school-edition background to create its matching PERSONAL-edition SILVER counterpart. Asset type: an EMPTY vertical background artwork for a teacher mobile app feature comparison card. Preserve the original restrained composition and shallow embossed curved layers near the extreme upper-right and lower-right edges. Change ONLY its palette and material mood: remove ALL gold, orange, yellow, bronze, warm beige and champagne tones. Use near-white pearl silver (#FAFBFD / #F5F7FA) for at least 85 percent of the canvas and very pale cool silver-gray (#E4E9F0) for the cropped peripheral curved layers. Refined satin silver highlights, subtle soft gray shadows, extremely low contrast. This should visually pair with the warm gold school card but read as a clean, understated silver personal tier. All of the left 80 percent and entire center must remain very quiet almost-white for small dark text and icons. Exactly the same 2:3 portrait composition. NO content: no text, no letters, no labels, no icons, no logo, no badges, no user interface, no QR code, no border, no full card mockup. No gradients with blue/purple/pink, no metallic mirror chrome, no grain/noise, no sparkles, no fabric, no central objects. Opaque background. Mature, minimalist commercial membership-card finish.
